title: Excellent visit
text: Our guide William showed us the palaces and explained their history and details. The visit was wonderful and highly recommended.

title: Expedited tour and excellent guide
text:
Visit highly recommended.
The Alhambra at night is one of the most beautiful places to see.
Guillermo Lopez was an excellent guide.
author: O592TAcarloso

title: Superb experience
text:
We hired a guided tour for the night tour of the Alhambra, and our guide was Rosa. It was an amazing experience! The guide was super attentive and pleasant, explained everything in detail and told us a thousand anecdotes of the monument. 
I am from Granada, and would definitely love to repeat a visit with her. It got too short.
author: elennapr

title: Great visit thanks to Hamdi
text: On July 23, 2021 we made the night visit to the Alhambra with Hamdi as a guide. The experience was wonderful. It was very exciting to see how I explained everything with such passion and feeling. I wish it could have lasted longer, because we enjoyed it so much. Hamdi is exceptional. Unfortunately he had to deal with an uncomfortable and unpleasant situation, because there was a couple who rather showed up for the visit with any intention but to see and admire the Alhambra. title: Magic night
text:
The Palaces inside, the views from the balconies, the lights of the Alhambra at night... I could not choose. Highlighting the treatment of Juan Domingo, our guide, explained everything in detail, from architecture to history, and not counting that each sentence repeated it in English for an English family that accompanied us. Very attentive and prepared.
